prompt.project_info: Create a realistic casual nightlife snapshot of an original approved adult model in a dark bar or semi-outdoor pub setting.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult woman with a short ash-brown center-parted bob, loose strands, light brown eyes, septum piercing, playful wink, and tongue-out expression sits casually on a bar stool. Preserve her original visible tattoos. She wears a black tank top, an open light-blue-white-black plaid flannel, denim miniskirt, and small black belt.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle view looking down, subject near a round stone or metal table, faint seated patrons in the dark background, clear glasses and pitcher, a cigarette pack with any visible brand treated as replaceable, and one lit cigarette held in her lowered hand.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh direct on-camera flash, sharp rear shadows, bright slightly overexposed skin, dark nighttime surroundings, raw Y2K grunge streetwear mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic 1200x1200 casual snapshot, high-angle phone perspective, direct flash, slight lens distortion, visible natural texture and imperfect exposure, restrained color treatment.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic 1200x1200 Y2K flash snapshot of an original approved adult woman with a short ash-brown center-parted bob, loose strands, septum piercing, playful wink, and tongue-out expression sitting on a bar stool. Preserve her visible tattoos. She wears a black tank top, open light-blue-white-black plaid flannel, denim miniskirt, and small black belt. A round stone or metal table holds glasses, a pitcher, and a replaceable cigarette pack; she holds one lit cigarette in her lowered hand. Dark bar or semi-outdoor pub, faint patrons behind her, harsh direct flash, sharp shadows, raw grunge streetwear atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, childlike features, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, graphic smoke inhalation, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, over-saturated, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed anatomy

assets.name: Y2K bar snapshot reference
assets.usage: Match the adult identity, bob haircut, expression, tattoos, outfit, stool pose, bar setting, and direct-flash look.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve adult identity, face, facial structure, tattoos, outfit, pose, prop arrangement, and flash atmosphere. Cigarette-pack branding, logos, typography, products, and environmental details are replaceable; keep them editable and do not introduce unrelated brands.
